The key issue is that the celery_app.py file in the Docker container still has the old import path. Please run these commands on the server:

```bash
# 1. First, let's see what's actually in the container
sudo docker-compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml run --rm celery ls -la

# 2. Check the celery_app.py content
sudo docker-compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml run --rm celery cat celery_app.py | grep -A5 -B5 "include="

# 3. Apply the fix
sudo cp /home/john_edaisystems_com/abom/api/celery_app.py /opt/abom/api/celery_app.py

# 4. Force rebuild
sudo docker-compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml build --no-cache celery

# 5. Restart
sudo docker-compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml restart celery
```

The document upload is failing because the Celery worker keeps crashing, which prevents async document processing from working.
